comment: Divergence ledger — read by the unified corpus gate (corpus_gate); BOTH
channels gate commits. Replaces the report-only known_diffs.json. Entries
mask NOTHING silently: each pins WHERE and HOW MUCH a case may diverge on a
channel and FAILS the gate when stale (a divergence that no longer exceeds
the tier floor, or an entry whose scope never matched). Envelopes are per-
case, per-channel, per-scope MEASURED facts with a mandatory cause+source —
NEVER a tolerance (tier floors in tests/harness are untouched and structurally
unreachable from here). Every add/widen/flip lands as a population-lock diff.
Kinds: 'divergence' (field-granular envelope, re-asserted within its pin),
'skip' (hard-crash decks, the other channel still gates), 'exclusion' (proven
upstream bug poisons scoped comparisons, everything else compared).

causes.fpc-delphi-ulp: Delphi(EPRI r4133)-vs-FPC(dss_capi 0.14.5/port) last-ulp libm differences amplified through the solve; the port matches the pinned FPC 0.14.5 oracle EXACTLY (the capi_v0145 channel is bit-clean) while r4133's Delphi build settles a near-identical state a few ulp away. Same class as the proven dSpeed cancellation floor (CLAUDE.md); a floor of the cross-engine build, not a port bug.
causes.iteration-count-delta: Solve/control fixpoint iteration-count deltas vs r4133: Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp rounding shifts convergence-check outcomes and the reworked controls iterate differently (AutoTrans+RegControl reg-tap, GenDispatcher dispatch). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's EXACT count on capi_v0145; on r4133 the state is near-identical in a different iteration count.
causes.injection-fpc-delphi-ulp: Injection RHS entries a small factor above the calibrated faer-vs-KLU floor on IndMach-bearing asymmetric decks: Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp amplified by the machine model (same class as the dSpeed cancellation floor). Injection assembly + machine model byte-identical across the EPRI delta.
causes.storage-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders StorageController-dispatched Storage properties (.kw / %stored / kwhstored) to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — a Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str last-digit RENDERING difference, not an op-point move (expected == actual rounded to 6 sf). The port matches the pinned FPC oracle. Ledgered as exact-pair property/probe entries (discrete state, never an envelope).
causes.pvsystem-display-precision: EPRI r4133's Delphi renders the PVSystem kvar/kva property to ~6 significant figures where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 — the same Delphi-vs-FPC Format/Str rendering difference as storage-display-precision, exact-pair only.
causes.property-format-brackets: dss_capi's rewritten property system renders array-valued PropertyValue with brackets ('[ 1900 1500 2300]') where EPRI returns plain space-separated ('1900 1500 2300') — a property-rendering difference (dss_capi docs/known_differences.md). Exact-pair only.
causes.eventlog-trailing-space: EPRI r4133 writes a trailing space after relay/control event-log action text ('...LOCKED OUT '); the port (matching dss_capi) trims it. A whitespace rendering artifact on the diffing line only.
causes.harmonics-ieee519-r4133: The documented r4088->r4133 harmonics-mode voltage move on the IEEE_519 filter deck (WP-U0.2; docs/upgrade/sweeps): node V ~4.3e-4 at pcc with the assembled Y bit-identical. Source-confirmed byte-identical harmonics path r4088=r4133 => a build-to-build Delphi last-ulp drift amplified by the near-resonance of the 519 filter (ill-conditioned harmonics fixpoint), NOT a portable behavior change. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle and its own physically-correct harmonics solution.
causes.autotrans-regcontrol-tap: AutoTrans + RegControl reg-tap resolves on a different discrete step FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): a last-ulp voltage nudges the tap decision across a boundary, moving the atf node V. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; the engine-to-engine sweep shows the same 'regcontrols differ: [rat]', so it is FPC-vs-Delphi, not a port bug.
causes.makeposseq-fpc-delphi: MakePosSequence positive-sequence reduction last-digit drift FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): the reduction averages/collapses the model, amplifying transcendental last-ulp so node V drifts above the tight makeposseq tier. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; the reduction path is byte-identical r4088=r4133.
causes.reduce-fpc-delphi: Circuit-reduction produces a different reduced network FPC(port) vs Delphi(EPRI r4133): keep/merge/switch handling collapses branches differently, so a reduced Line YPrim can differ structurally and node V drifts. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle's reduced network EXACTLY (mandatory gate green incl. YPrim).
causes.ckt24-regcontrol-conditioning: ckt24 substation RegControl/LDC tap-current at the SubXFMR ultra-switch (1e-8 ohm stitch, Y~1e8 S): the near-cancellation floors at rel ~1.2e-7, and Delphi-vs-FPC last-ulp nudges the substation node V ~1.2x over the faer-vs-KLU-calibrated pinned tol. Documented conditioning floor (STATUS CF-D 'SubXFMR ultra-switch'); the port matches the pinned FPC oracle.
causes.vsource-nearzero-power: Vsource unenergized-conductor power near-zero common mode: EPRI r4133 reports exactly (0,0) on the floating conductor where the port reports ~1e-4 VA (rel ~1e-7 on a 1 kV source) — the near-ideal-source/floating floor class. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle.
causes.monitor-seq-magnitude-drift: Sequence-magnitude monitor channel (V2, mode=32 seq-voltage) drifts above the 1e-6 monitor-channel abs floor: the symmetrical-component transform (Fortescue A-matrix over complex node voltages) amplifies Delphi-vs-FPC transcendental last-ulp. The port matches the pinned FPC oracle; Meters/Monitor.pas byte-identical r4088=r4133.
causes.epri-303-crash: EPRI r4133 raises a #303/#58614 access violation on this deck (binary/MMF GrowthShape, line/cable spacing, or the dss-ext CapControl Type=Follow ControlSignal feature) where the port and the pinned 0.14.5 oracle solve it correctly; the r4133 channel cannot compare it. dss-extensions-era known regression; no port action. The capi_v0145 channel still gates the deck fully.
causes.ncim-oppoint: NCIM (Newton-Current-Injection) is a 0.15.x/r4133 solver the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 lacks entirely (Set algorithm=NCIM ignored, Export deltaf #24713) — so the capi_v0145 channel cannot gate an NCIM deck. On r4133 the NCIM iteration converges to a slightly different PV/Q operating point than the Rust NCIM port (WP-U1.7), so node V / injection / source current / iteration count differ within a measured envelope.
causes.dynexp-d14: Dynamic-expression (DynExp) decks: the retired capi015 (0.15.0b4) froze the state-var seed via a D14 Exit-no-op; the pinned 0.14.5 and the port swing, and EPRI r4133 evaluates the dynamic expression a few ulp differently, so node V drifts within a measured envelope on r4133 (D14; DIVERGENCES.md; STATUS UPGRADE).
causes.gfm-pctstored-rounding: Grid-forming (GFM) storage decks: the r4133 physics matches the port (the port adopted the r4133 Isc1 default, DIVERGENCES.md #b5) EXCEPT the Storage.%stored property getter STRING, which r4133's Delphi rounds to ~4-6 decimals (e.g. 92.4321) where the port/pinned-oracle return full f64 (92.4320641163609) — a getter rendering difference, exact-pair only. On the capi_v0145 channel the deck cannot gate: 0.14.5's different Isc1 default makes the assembled system-Y differ wholesale (x1000), a deliberate model default the port follows r4133 on.
causes.regcontrol-idle: The RegControl `idle` property is a 0.15.x/r4133 feature the pinned dss_capi 0.14.5 rejects (#110 Unknown parameter 'idle') — so the capi_v0145 channel cannot gate the idle-regulator deck. On r4133 the idle regulator leaves the node V a small measured envelope away from the Rust port.
causes.linespacing-normamps: Line built from LineSpacing+wiredata: dss_capi 0.14.5 reports Line.normamps=230 (the spacing default) where the port and the newer engines (capi015/r4133) report 730 (the wire NormAmps rating carried through) — a 0.14.5-era property-derivation the newer line-constants path fixed; the port follows the corrected value. r4133 additionally #303-crashes this deck (skip). Exact-pair property entry on capi_v0145.
